text.config.cave_dweller_config.title: Cave Dweller Settings
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.G: Whether or not to give darkness when it's chasing.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.D: Whether or not to disappear when target becomes invalid.

SPOILERS! Enables the following:
A scoreboard showing dweller data/timers
Slimes with glowing spawning at every spawn attempt
Dweller has glowing applied upon spawning
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.C:
From 0% (0.0) to 100% (1.0)
Chance for it to start making it's way to you once spawned in.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.R:
(in seconds)
Minimum time before spawning in.

(in seconds)
Maximum time before spawning in.
NOTE: Cooldown is this * 2!

From 0% (0.0) to 100% (1.0).
Chance for calm time to be max * 2.
Minimum time between Cave Dweller noises

(in seconds)
These get louder as it gets closer.

(in seconds)
These play once it's spawned in, and
replace the mod's regular cave noises.
Assuming it doesn't try to trick you.

(in seconds)
A high value creates a quiet start with a long delay between sounds,
followed by a dramatic spike in sound frequency as time runs out.
A low value triggers cave noises almost immediately,
keeping the noises frequent and mostly unchanging.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.S:
Automatically accounts for custom world heights!
NOTE: Option is ignored if surface spawning is enabled.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.A:
Allows for surface spawning.
NOTE: Will spawn on the surface regardless of spawn height set.
May be altered in the future.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.S:
Sets the maximum light threshold required for
spawning on the surface.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.B:
Sets the maximum light threshold required for
spawning underground.
Recommended level is below 4.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.G:
(in seconds)
'Grace period' is a timer that starts ticking down when
you're no longer a 'spelunker' by definition.
Once it starts ticking down, all other timers slow to half speed.
Resets to max once you meet the requirements
to be a spelunker again.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.S:
From how far it can spot you.
Also determines how far it will search for players.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.T:
(in seconds)
Time before it disappears.
NOTE: Won't disappear when you're looking.

(in seconds)
Time before it disappears while chasing.
NOTE: Won't disappear when you're looking.
text.config.cave_dweller_config.option.M: Used as a basis for ALL movement
